convert_ovis_transformer_checkpoint: convert an Ovis-Image transformer checkpoint to Diffusers format and save pretrained model
load_original_checkpoint: load an Ovis-Image checkpoint from HuggingFace Hub or a local safetensors file
swap_scale_shift: swap scale and shift weights in AdaLayerNormContinuous linear projection for Diffusers compatibility

run_ovis_conversion_cli: run the Ovis-Image to Diffusers conversion script with command line arguments for repo id and output path
